name: Travel along the Tree
description: When you activate your Rage and while your Rage is active, you can use a Bonus Action to teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. In addition, when you activate your Rage, you can teleport one willing creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself to an unoccupied space you can see within 60 feet of yourself.

review.notes: authored from PHB 2024, mechanic not yet wired to activities
